rival_reading: A field exposure could produce interrupted transfers and hurried kit logs; the mismatch alone does not show that officials caused or hid a containment failure.
gloss: A transfer record closes before its listed bed is empty while a kit remains with the paperwork.
title: Transfer complete, bed still occupied
body: The outgoing count was signed before the last bed emptied. A child's sticker is on the first-aid kit; the form's only completed field is the case number, not the passenger.

rival_reading: An intake during road restrictions could document supplies before tracing their source; a field worker's delayed meal may reflect an ordinary response disruption.
gloss: A field worker's supplies are logged before a source entry is completed.
title: Source field left blank
body: The bandage and full water bottle were logged against a field worker before the source box was filled in. The worker's lunch break was marked late; the only complete count is for used wraps.
